protocol: V91 sealed second-source RT-IoT2022 external evaluation
source_provenance: RT-IoT2022 real-time IoT infrastructure; bidirectional network flow features derived from captured traffic; simulated attack scenarios against IoT infrastructure.
test_scope: entire RT_IOT2022.csv file discovered by required Attack_type column; no row subsampling based on labels or predictions

normal_label_rule_frozen_before_scoring.normalization: lowercase alphanumeric only; mqtt/thing_speak/wipro_bulb variants accepted

model_contract.threshold_rule: lowest deterministic threshold meeting <=1% empirical benign FPR on UNSW validation

forbidden_after_freeze: choose feature set/model/hyperparameters/threshold from RT-IoT2022 metrics
remove hard RT-IoT2022 attack or benign classes after seeing results
relabel controlled testbed traffic as production-enterprise traffic
claim_boundary: Independent second-source captured IoT/attack traffic benchmark. Controlled testbed evidence, not production-enterprise validation, not MITRE-stage validation, and not verified pre-compromise forecasting.
